children.description: Phenology: — The sprouting of the inflorescences occurs between August and September and the anthesis between October and November. In contrast, the flowering of M. schottiana, the most similar species, follows about 20 days later. Staminate flower anthesis precedes that of the pistillate flowers by a few days. The development of the young fruits begins shortly after anthesis, often even before shedding of the calyptra. Fruits were found mature between April and June.
